boost.en: On the “pro minimum wage” side, supporters argue that it can also boost morale and productivity.
boost.zh: 在“支持最低工资”的一方，支持者认为这还能提高士气和生产力。

boost.en: Aura farming is when people post highly edited or curated photos online to boost their image.
boost.zh: Aura farming 指的是人们在网上发布经过精心修饰、刻意打造的照片，以此来提升自己的形象。

boost.en: Now, Georgie, is there anything you do to boost your immune system?
boost.zh: 那么，Georgie，你有什么方法来增强你的免疫系统吗？

boost.en: But people who post the videos say they boost their confidence.
boost.zh: 但发布视频的人表示，这确实增强了他们的自信心。

boost.en: Dr Karan also gives some hacks – good solutions or pieces of advice – to help boost your fibre intake.
boost.zh: Karan博士还给出了一些“hacks”——好的解决方法或建议——来帮助提高你的纤维摄入量。

bore.en: Women's work is a negative term for the boring and repetitive tasks which are stereotypically done by women.
bore.zh: “Women's work”（女性的工作）是一个贬义词，指那些刻板印象中由女性完成的无聊且重复的任务。

bore.en: On Rote, cleaning, cooking and sweeping are considered women's work – a negative term for boring and repetitive tasks which are traditionally done by women.
bore.zh: 在罗地岛，清洁、做饭和扫地被认为是女性的工作——这是一个贬义词，指传统上由女性完成的无聊且重复的任务。

bore.en: It bore little resemblance to any modern university: no sprawling campus, no central library, no stone quadrangles where students wandered around in gowns.
bore.zh: 它与任何现代大学几乎毫无相似之处：没有错落有致的校园、没有中央图书馆、也没有穿着长袍的学生闲逛的石头方庭。

bore.en: …which was the right answer. Yay! Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with roll your eyes – to move your eyes upwards to show you are bored or annoyed.
bore.zh: ……这就是正确的答案。太棒了！让我们回顾一下学到的词汇，从“翻白眼”开始——向上转动眼睛以表现出你感到无聊或恼火。

bore.en: I’ve sat in university lectures and business meetings where someone asks a question, and halfway through that question, everyone in the room is already confused or bored or frustrated.
bore.zh: 我曾坐在大学阶梯教室和商务会议中，听到有人提出一个问题，结果问题还没问到一半，屋里的每个人就已经感到困惑、无聊或沮丧了。

bold.en: Someone who dresses loud likes to wear clothes with bright colours and bold designs.
bold.zh: 穿得很显眼（dresses loud）的人喜欢穿颜色鲜艳、设计大胆的衣服。

bold.en: They weren’t as heavily armoured as the Roman troops, but they were bold and adaptable.
bold.zh: 他们的盔甲没有罗马军队那么厚重，但他们勇敢且适应力极强。

bold.en: Throughout the campaign, voters were repeatedly shown bold and dramatic claims.
bold.zh: 在整个竞选期间，选民们不断看到大胆且戏剧性的主张。

bold.en: Someone who is sassy is bold, confident and cheeky.
bold.zh: sassy（时髦俏皮的）的人很大胆、自信且带点调皮。

bold.en: The adjective sassy means bold, confident and cheeky.
bold.zh: 形容词sassy意为大胆、自信而又有点厚脸皮的。

bond.en: It takes time for them to build a bond of trust with their horse.
bond.zh: 他们需要时间与马建立信任纽带。

bond.en: The phrase bond of trust is a strong feeling of reliance and confidence between two people.
bond.zh: 信任纽带（bond of trust）是指两人之间强烈的依赖感和信心。

bond.en: Babies move their arms and legs to create a bond with their parents.
bond.zh: 婴儿移动胳膊和腿是为了与父母建立亲密关系。

bond.en: It’s a grisly tale, but yet another reminder of the longevity of this human- canine bond.
bond.zh: 这是一个毛骨悚然的故事，但也是人与犬之间这种纽带历久弥坚的又一个证明。

bond.en: But there was a side effect. A huge inflow of capital into assets: stocks, bonds, and crucially, property.
bond.zh: 但也有一个副作用。大量资本流入了资产市场：股票、债券，最关键的是，房地产。

bow.en: Would they: a) offer a gift, b) pull their earlobes, or c) bow down?
bow.zh: 他们会：a）送礼物，b）拉耳垂，还是 c）鞠躬？

bow.en: Ooh, I am going to guess c) bow down. OK.
bow.zh: 哦，我要猜 c）鞠躬。好的。

bow.en: Buses stop in the middle of the road, workers put down their tools, and TV chatshow hosts bow their heads in respect.
bow.zh: 公交车停在路中央，工人们放下工具，电视脱口秀主持人低头以示敬意。

bow.en: He has bowed where he was told to bow, photographed what he was allowed to photograph, and said nothing that might cause offence.
bow.zh: 该鞠躬的地方他都鞠了躬，只拍了被允许拍的照片，也没说任何可能冒犯到谁的话。

bow.en: He has bowed where he was told to bow, photographed what he was allowed to photograph, and said nothing that might cause offence.
bow.zh: 该鞠躬的地方他都鞠了躬，只拍了被允许拍的照片，也没说任何可能冒犯到谁的话。

boundary.en: Unlike other traditional food such as sushi, modern versions of ramen push the boundaries.
boundary.zh: 不像寿司等其他传统食物，现代版本的拉面在不断突破极限。

boundary.en: If you push the boundaries, you act in a way which challenges normal acceptable behaviour.
boundary.zh: 如果你 push the boundaries（突破常规 / 挑战极限），你的行为就会挑战正常的可接受行为。

boundary.en: A pale, P-A-L-E, as a noun, is literally a fenced boundary, an enclosure.
boundary.zh: “Pale”这个词作为名词，字面意思是栅栏边界或围场。

boundary.en: Landowners enclosed common land. Fences and boundaries were built around the land.
boundary.zh: 地主们圈占了公有地。土地周围建起了围栏和边界。

boundary.en: Use “in” when something is inside an enclosed space or within clear boundaries.Think of in as “inside boundaries”.
boundary.zh: 当某物在一个封闭空间内部或在清晰的边界之内时，使用“in”。把 in 想象成“在边界内部”。

board.en: He boarded a plane and flew to Togo, then to Morocco, where he had property.
board.zh: 他登上一架飞机飞往多哥，然后前往他拥有房产的摩洛哥。

board.en: Theseus and the other young Athenians boarded a ship and sailed to Crete.
board.zh: 忒修斯和其他年轻的雅典人登上一艘船，驶向克里特岛。

board.en: He boards a plane for South Africa. He is sixty years old.
board.zh: 他登上了飞往南非的飞机。那年他六十岁。

board.en: If you get on board with something, you agree to a plan of action and get involved.
board.zh: 如果你参与（get on board with）某事，你就同意了一项行动计划并参与其中。

board.en: A young man is standing in Pyongyang International Airport, waiting to board a flight back to Beijing.
board.zh: 一个年轻人站在平壤国际机场，等着登上飞回北京的航班。

booth.en: The booth can be a single striped canvas sheet thrown over a frame.
booth.zh: 这个布罩可以只是一张套在框架上的红白条纹帆布。

booth.en: The booth, with its tall stripes of red and white, was already portable.
booth.zh: 那个有着醒目红白条纹的布罩本来就已经很便携了。

bounce.en: And in many ways, it worked. The world bounced back.
bounce.zh: 在很多方面，它确实起作用了。世界经济复苏了。

bounce.en: He bounced from place to place, chasing the next opportunity.
bounce.zh: 此后他辗转各地，四处寻找下一个机会。

bound.en: This means choosing goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time Bound.
bound.zh: 这意味着选择具体的（Specific）、可衡量的（Measurable）、可实现的（Achievable）、相关的（Relevant）和有时间限制的（Time Bound）目标。

bound.en: When we think of a book today, we usually imagine pages bound together with a cover.
bound.zh: 今天当我们想到一本书时，我们通常会想象用封面装订在一起的书页。

bound.en: Are these books? Well, they were written texts bound together.
bound.zh: 这些是书吗？嗯，它们是装订在一起的书面文本。

bound.en: Next up we'll be moving into the nineteenth century: the Act of Union that bound Ireland formally to Britain, the Great Famine, and the early movements for self-determination.
bound.zh: 下一集我们将进入 19 世纪：将爱尔兰正式与英国绑在一起的《联合法案》、大饥荒，以及早期的民族自决运动。

bound.en: We’ll talk about this more in a few minutes, when we talk about speaking, but for the purposes of listening, these models have come on leaps and bounds since 2022.
bound.zh: 几分钟后当我们谈论口语时会更多地讨论这一点，但就听力而言，自 2022 年以来，这些模型已经取得了长足的进步。

bonus.en: On Friday, I’ll release a Thinking in English Bonus Episode on Patreon, which will cover the other five terms.
bonus.zh: 周五，我将在Patreon上发布一期《Thinking in English》的额外福利节目，其中将涵盖另外五个术语。

bonus.en: This episode was originally recorded as a Bonus Episode for my Patreon community a year ago… subscribe to Patreon for more great episodes.
bonus.zh: 这集节目一年前最初是为我的 Patreon 社区录制的专属节目……订阅 Patreon 获取更多精彩节目。

bonus.en: To celebrate the occasion, I wrote a Thinking in English Bonus Episode on the things I achieved or was proud of doing in my twenties.
bonus.zh: 为了庆祝这个时刻，我写了一期 Thinking in English 的特别节目，盘点我在二十多岁时取得的成就或引以为豪的事情。

bonus.en: You can find out more about the difference between prime ministers and presidents in my bonus episode that I will be releasing on Friday, so later this week.
bonus.zh: 你可以在我周五（也就是本周晚些时候）发布的加更节目中了解更多关于首相和总统区别的信息。

bonus.en: And actually, in the bonus episode talking about Other Wonders of the World, I included Guanabara Bay, which had been in CNN’s Natural Wonders of the World list.
bonus.zh: 事实上，在讨论其他世界奇迹的特别节目里，我也把瓜纳巴拉湾收录进去了，它曾登上美国有线电视新闻网的世界自然奇迹名单。

boast.en: And if you are anything like me, you are probably bombarded with adverts for AI-tutors with all sorts of promises, from boasts about how many billions of downloads they have to promises to make you fluent in 90 days.
boast.zh: 如果你和我一样，你可能也会被各种人工智能导师的广告狂轰滥炸，它们有着各种各样的承诺，从吹嘘自己有多少亿下载量到承诺在 90 天内让你流利。

bomb.en: The hydrogen bomb, which was developed shortly after, was literally hundreds of times more powerful.
bomb.zh: 随后不久研制出的氢弹，威力实际上是前者的数百倍。

bomb.en: Some bombs were disguised as parcels, others as pieces of scientific equipment.
bomb.zh: 有些炸弹伪装成包裹，有些伪装成科学仪器。

bomb.en: During World War II, Berlin was a major target for Allied bombing.
bomb.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，柏林是盟军轰炸的主要目标。

bomb.en: For in the destructive potential of the atomic bomb lay opportunity.
bomb.zh: 因为在原子弹的毁灭潜力中，蕴含着机遇。

bomb.en: But this was also something of a ticking time bomb.
bomb.zh: 但这也是一颗某种程度上的定时炸弹。

boycott.en: There were organised boycotts of Tesla, Musk’s electric car company.
boycott.zh: 人们组织了对马斯克电动汽车公司特斯拉的抵制活动。

boycott.en: Then in 2021, another referendum was held, but during this referendum, the pro-independence movement, the movement calling for New Caledonia to be a country not part of France, boycotted the vote due to disagreements about COVID-19.
boycott.zh: 然后在2021年，又举行了一次公投，但在这次公投期间，独立派运动（即呼吁新喀里多尼亚成为一个不属于法国的国家的运动）由于对COVID-19的分歧而抵制了投票。

boycott.en: The majority of New Caledonia has voted to remain part of France in those three referendums between 2018 and 2021, although the final vote in 2021 was boycotted by the pro-independence movement, which means most of them didn’t vote.
boycott.zh: 在2018年至2021年期间的三次公投中，新喀里多尼亚多数人投票决定继续留在法国，尽管2021年的最后一次投票遭到独立派运动的抵制，这意味着他们大多数人没有投票。

boycott.en: Of those who voted, around 65% voted to reduce the term limit, with 35% voting against it, but this was to be expected; the Prime Minister, Giorgia Meloni, who was one of the major critics of the proposal, encouraged her supporters to boycott the referendum, so it was hardly surprising that more “yes” supporters turned up to vote than the “no” side.
boycott.zh: 在投票的人中，大约65%的人投票赞成缩短年限，35%的人投票反对，但这也在意料之中；强烈批评该提案的主要推手之一、总理 Giorgia Meloni 鼓励她的支持者抵制这场公投，因此支持“赞成”票的人数多于“反对”阵营也就不足为奇了。

bolt.en: Tourism was practically dead, foreign investors had bolted, and bread lines were sparking riots.
bolt.zh: 旅游业几乎瘫痪，外国投资者逃之夭夭，排队买面包引发了骚乱。

bolt.en: Think about an elite sprinter, like Usain Bolt.
bolt.zh: 想想顶级短跑运动员，比如尤塞恩·博尔特（Usain Bolt）。
